hero.title: Make AI truly yours.
hero.eyebrow: Open-Source Personal AI Foundation · Local-First · Shared Context
hero.lead: Set up local models or cloud services once on your computer so your apps can use them right away—while your companion’s memory and permissions stay in your hands and carry from app to app.
runtime.title: Nimi Runtime, your home computing hub
runtime.description: Run your Mac or Windows PC as your always-ready AI host; the Runtime architecture lets admitted web and mobile clients connect back to your local models and companion memory with owner approval.
runtime.caption: Today’s public installers deliver the Apple Silicon Mac and Windows desktop host; remote web and mobile connections require an admitted client origin and direct peer connectivity (standalone mobile apps are not yet in app stores, and nimi.ai hosts no web chat).
hero.availability: Public beta · Macs with Apple silicon and Windows x86_64 · Nimi account required
hero.peek: Take an idea from thought to reality.
hero.metaTitle: Nimi | The personal AI foundation you control
hero.metaDescription: Nimi is an open-source personal AI foundation: unify local models and cloud services on your computer, with inspectable memory and cross-app continuity.

security.accessDetail: Access depends on the app’s declared permissions and the current protected session.
security.checkDetail: In text.generate, the check looks only for supported, complete, unencrypted PEM private keys and GitHub classic personal access token (PAT) formats.
security.request: Help me inspect this connection log.
security.ready: Edit the example request to explore the content-check flow.
security.refused: The example input was blocked. Your draft is preserved for you to edit and try again.
security.editNote: Your draft is preserved. Edit it to try the demo again.
security.sent: The example flow is complete. Nothing was sent to a model.
security.scope: Inputs · Output as it’s generated · Complete tool arguments
security.limit: Once displayed, text cannot be recalled. Images, audio, video, and arbitrary encodings are out of scope. This is not comprehensive leak prevention, and it does not detect prompt injection.
security.note: Content checks are a developer preview in current source builds. See release notes for packaged availability.
security.noSandbox: These boundaries cover Nimi-managed calls, not the entire operating system or every action an app can take.

pillars.title: Set up once, let every AI app work in sync
pillars.body: Stop juggling separate model downloads, API keys, and scattered chat histories inside every tool—Nimi brings compute, memory, and permissions together on your computer.
pillars.computeTitle: Set up models once, use them across apps
pillars.computeBody: No more downloading multi-gigabyte runtimes for every new AI tool. Configure local open models or your own cloud keys once in Nimi Home, and share them across chat, voice, and creative apps.
pillars.contextTitle: Switch apps without starting from scratch
pillars.contextBody: What a companion remembers lives on your computer—you can see where every memory came from, edit it, or delete it anytime, and carry the conversation from Nimi Home into Zhiyu with your consent.
pillars.governanceTitle: Clear permissions, local data in your hands
pillars.governanceBody: Apps state clearly whether they need AI models, external sources, or messaging channels. Ungranted actions never run behind your back, and each app’s own local data stays separate.
portals.title: From everyday companions and apps to the architecture underneath
portals.body: Whether you want to meet voiced companions, try ready-made AI tools, inspect the platform architecture, or build an app of your own, jump straight in.
portals.homeBody: Manage local AI, hear voiced characters, step into shared worlds, and start everyday conversations from your desktop hub.
portals.appsBody: Try Nimi Official apps alongside community open-source tools like Vane, SillyTavern, VideoLingo, and OpenMontage adapted onto Nimi.
portals.platformBody: See how compute, memory, and identity are separated across three domains, plus the 11 multimodal capabilities and safety checks.
portals.developersTitle: Build or Adapt Your Own App
portals.developersBody: Skip bundling heavy inference runtimes—ship lightweight AI apps with the TypeScript SDK, Vercel AI Adapter, Kit UI, and App Tools.
